tools.name: plutio_get_workspace
tools.description: The Plutio workspace this API client is connected to: name, domain, currency, locale, timezone and settings. GET /businesses.

tools.name: plutio_list_people
tools.description: People: clients and your own team members (name, role, contactEmails, contactPhones, companies). Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /people.

tools.name: plutio_list_companies
tools.description: Companies (clients that group people): title, industry, people, contact details. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /companies.

tools.name: plutio_list_projects
tools.description: Projects: name, client, status, dates, budget, billing rate. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /projects.

tools.name: plutio_list_task_boards
tools.description: Task boards of projects. A project has one or more boards that hold tasks. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /task-boards.

tools.name: plutio_list_task_groups
tools.description: Task groups (columns/lists on a task board). Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /task-groups.

tools.name: plutio_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks: title, status (incomplete, completed, overdue), dueDate, assignedTo, projectId, taskBoardId. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /tasks.

tools.name: plutio_list_statuses
tools.description: Custom statuses (for projects and similar records): title, type, entityType. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /statuses.

tools.name: plutio_list_time_entries
tools.description: Time entries: personId, projectId, taskId, startedAt, stoppedAt, time in seconds, billing amount and rate. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /time-tracks.

tools.name: plutio_list_categories
tools.description: Categories used to organize records such as time entries and transactions. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /categories.

tools.name: plutio_list_events
tools.description: Calendar events: title, startDate, endDate, location, participants. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /events.

tools.name: plutio_list_schedulers
tools.description: Scheduling pages (booking links) and their settings. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /scheduler.

tools.name: plutio_list_invoices
tools.description: Invoices: name, client, status (draft, pending, paid and so on), amount, amountPaid, currency, dueDate, issueDate. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /invoices.

tools.name: plutio_list_invoice_subscriptions
tools.description: Recurring invoice subscriptions: client, schedule, amount. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /invoice-subscriptions.

tools.name: plutio_list_transactions
tools.description: Payments and expenses: amount, currency, client, invoiceId, status, type, issueDate. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /transactions.

tools.name: plutio_list_proposals
tools.description: Proposals: name, client, status, amount. The text is in blocks: see plutio_get_document_blocks. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /proposals.

tools.name: plutio_list_contracts
tools.description: Contracts: name, client, status, signatures. The text is in blocks: see plutio_get_document_blocks. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /contracts.

tools.name: plutio_list_forms
tools.description: Forms (intake forms, questionnaires): name and status. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /forms.

tools.name: plutio_list_form_responses
tools.description: Submitted responses to forms. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /form-responses.

tools.name: plutio_list_notes
tools.description: Notes: title, descriptionHTML, entityType and entityId of the record they belong to. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /notes.

tools.name: plutio_list_comments
tools.description: Comments on tasks, files and conversations: bodyHTML, createdBy, entityType, entityId. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /comments.

tools.name: plutio_list_conversations
tools.description: Inbox conversations: subject, participants, last message. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /conversations.

tools.name: plutio_list_wiki_pages
tools.description: Pages of the Plutio wiki / knowledge base. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /wiki-entities.

tools.name: plutio_list_files
tools.description: File records (name, size, folder, sharing). File contents are not downloaded. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /files.

tools.name: plutio_list_folders
tools.description: File folders. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /file-folders.

tools.name: plutio_list_custom_fields
tools.description: Custom field definitions (label, type, which records they apply to). Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /custom-fields.

tools.name: plutio_get_document_blocks
tools.description: The content blocks of a contract, proposal or invoice: the written text (textHTML) and, for invoices, the line items. A document record only holds block ids. GET /blocks (entityType and entityId are both required).

tools.name: plutio_create_person
tools.description: WRITE: add a person (a client by default) to the workspace. Returns the new record with its _id. POST /people.

tools.name: plutio_create_company
tools.description: WRITE: add a company, optionally linking existing people to it. Returns the new record. POST /companies.

tools.name: plutio_create_project
tools.description: WRITE: create a project. Plutio gives it a default status and a first task board (find it with plutio_list_task_boards). Returns the new record. POST /projects.

tools.name: plutio_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: add a task to a project's task board. Get taskBoardId from plutio_list_task_boards (projectId filter). New tasks start as incomplete. Returns the new record. POST /tasks.

tools.name: plutio_update_task
tools.description: WRITE: change a task's title, status (incomplete, completed, overdue), due date or description. Only the fields you pass change. Returns the updated record. PUT /tasks.

tools.name: plutio_log_time
tools.description: WRITE: record a time entry against a task. projectId must be the task's own project (read the task first). time is the length in seconds (5400 = 1.5 hours). POST /time-tracks.

tools.name: plutio_create_comment
tools.description: WRITE: post a comment on a task, file or conversation. Visible to everyone who can see that record. Returns the new record. POST /comments.

tools.name: plutio_create_event
tools.description: WRITE: add a calendar event. No invitations are sent. Returns the new record. POST /events.

tools.name: plutio_create_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT invoice for a person or company. The client cannot pay it and nothing is emailed. Add line items with plutio_add_invoice_items. Returns the new record. POST /invoices.

tools.name: plutio_add_invoice_items
tools.description: WRITE: put line items on an invoice that has none yet (an invoice made with plutio_create_invoice). Refuses an invoice that already has an items block. Plutio works out line totals, subtotal and total. POST /blocks.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plutio_list_comments, plutio_list_conversations, plutio_create_task, plutio_log_time · Private data: plutio_list_people, plutio_list_companies, plutio_list_projects, plutio_list_task_boards, plutio_list_task_groups, plutio_list_tasks, plutio_list_statuses, plutio_list_time_entries, plutio_list_categories, plutio_list_events, plutio_list_schedulers, plutio_list_invoices, plutio_list_invoice_subscriptions, plutio_list_transactions, plutio_list_proposals, plutio_list_contracts, plutio_list_forms, plutio_list_form_responses, plutio_list_notes, plutio_list_comments, plutio_list_conversations, plutio_list_wiki_pages, plutio_list_files, plutio_list_folders, plutio_list_custom_fields, plutio_get_document_blocks, plutio_create_person, plutio_create_company, plutio_create_project, plutio_create_task, plutio_update_task, plutio_log_time, plutio_create_comment, plutio_create_event, plutio_create_invoice · Public sink: plutio_create_person, plutio_create_company, plutio_create_project, plutio_create_task, plutio_log_time, plutio_create_comment, plutio_create_event, plutio_create_invoice, plutio_add_invoice_items.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
